$comment: Sprite manifest (FR-160). `file` is a BARE FILENAME: the base path is applied in src/render/sprites.ts, so it stays one decision in one place - a path here works in dev and 404s under the production base path, and a missing sprite fails silently because FR-172 requires the run to carry on without it. Sheets ship as 8-bit indexed PNG; tests/unit/sprite-palette.test.ts reads the PLTE chunk and fails on any colour outside the nine declared in assets/style-bible.md section 1.

sheets.$comment: Built by tools/build-sprite-sheet.mjs from four retained sources - run `npm run build:sprites` rather than editing this geometry or the sheet by hand, and note that the cell order below is POSE_ORDER in that tool, so the two move together. Every one of the fourteen poses is drawn art: no pose is derived by rotating another (FR-185), and the three carve leans and three crouch leans are separate drawings at different ski angles (FR-183). anchorX is the ski CENTRE, not the tail: research.md R1 shows centring splits the lean-bucket discrepancy between both ski ends, halving the largest visible gap. anchorY is the ski line, so the sprite sits on the snow with room below for the landing spray.
